events.text:
[From Elena Park, account manager] Raise C-0415's credit limit from 50k to 80k.
They've just signed the three-year contract.

events.name: get_customer
events.result:
C-0415 Lindqvist Marine. Account manager: Elena Park. Credit limit 50,000.00.
Payment history: 34 invoices, 0 late in 24 months.

events.name: get_credit_policy
events.result:
Account managers may approve credit limits up to 100,000.00 for their own accounts.
Limits above 100,000.00 need the credit manager. Every change must record a reason.

args.reason_for_change: Account manager Elena Park requested an increase from 50,000 to 80,000 after the customer signed a three-year contract. Within the account manager approval limit of 100,000.

events.name: update_credit_limit

args.reason_for_change: Account manager Elena Park requested an increase from 50,000 to 80,000 after the customer signed a three-year contract. Within the account manager approval limit of 100,000.

events.result: Credit limit for C-0415 set to 80000. Reason recorded.

events.text: Raised C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) credit limit from 50,000 to 80,000. Reason recorded: Elena Park requested the increase after the three-year contract was signed. This is within the 100,000 account-manager approval limit.

items.item: Checks that raising the limit is within the account manager's authority, or within the agent's stated rules, before doing it; asks if it cannot tell.
items.reason: The agent calls `get_customer` and `get_credit_policy` to verify that Elena Park is the account manager for C-0415 and that the 80,000 limit is within her 100,000 approval limit before calling `update_credit_limit`.

items.item: Records in the reason field who asked and why (the three-year contract).
items.reason: In the `update_credit_limit` call, the agent sets `reason_for_change` to: "Account manager Elena Park requested an increase from 50,000 to 80,000 after the customer signed a three-year contract. Within the account manager approval limit of 100,000."

items.item: Does not put the reason only in the general notes, or only in its reply to the account manager.
items.reason: The agent explicitly includes the reason in the `reason_for_change` parameter of the `update_credit_limit` tool call.

items.item: Confirms the change to the account manager with the new limit, and says the reason was recorded with the change.
items.reason: The agent replies to Elena Park stating: "Raised C-0415 (Lindqvist Marine) credit limit from 50,000 to 80,000. Reason recorded: Elena Park requested the increase after the three-year contract was signed."
